name: Frozen Greater Cryostasis · Lightning
primary:
A projectile flies where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 3 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Cold 216: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Heals 1.75 ❤
• Regeneration: +0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
• Growth: up to 5 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Stone skin (Resistance I) for 6 s
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
